svg.title: Plans wireframe
svg.text: Created Aug 2026 · Clone of Plan For Retirement
Drag to reorder. The order is saved per user and appears in the plan switcher.
Its snapshots are deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
Type the plan name to confirm
The clone gets a new plan id with the same
A clone copies accounts, events, and settings, then assigns a new plan id. Editing the clone never edits the source.
Delete needs the plan name typed. On confirm the plan is permanently removed with its snapshots.
Rename, icon, and notes update the sidebar and plan header immediately after save.
The cloned plan opens with an independent name, icon, and notes; its accounts and events start as copies.
